authorization.scope: Publish this reviewed rankings feature through CI-checked PR, GitHub Pages and both production storefronts. No author outreach, Catalog/admission mutation, real Profile writes or plugin installation.

rules: Only approved fixed-Commit Catalog entries qualify; never promote candidates or unlisted entries
Popular: GitHub stars descending, stable id tie-break; unknown counters excluded, not zero
Recommended: existing featured flag and Catalog order; no fabricated recommendation
Essentials: star winner per Catalog category, deterministic tie-break, collapse multiple category wins per plugin
Small derived ranking snapshot only; no enlarged main Catalog; reuse build-time GitHub read-only enrichment; expose observation timestamp and coverage
Bilingual accessible tabs, 20 rows/page, compact responsive layout; no install controls
gates: browser desktop/mobile interaction and visual checks
fresh main and exact scoped files
CI success at exact PR head
Pages artifact at exact merge SHA
two atomic site refreshes with preserved backups
public artifact digest and all three rankings UI readback

rollback.production: Existing reviewed refresh service retains complete previous release and file hashes; health failure restores previous symlink. Revert source through CI-checked PR; never reset contact ledger.
